goal: Provide a repeatable, bounded real-robot evaluation of SO-101 data capture, imitation policies and inference timing without claiming OpenRGD hardware safety certification.
required_preflight: Confirm leader/follower identity, exact robot/config revisions and USB device mapping for this session.
Inspect mechanical workspace, electrical supply, pinch hazards and an operator-reachable safe-stop/torque-disable procedure; stop if not validated.
Verify calibration correspondence under supervision and log calibration hash or explicitly mark unavailable.
Fix camera positions, frame resolution and FPS; measure video/state timestamp synchronization or record as unknown.
Record LeRobot, Python, driver, policy/model and adapter Git commits plus sensor/joint order and action units.
Predeclare task success definition, reset procedure, exclusion criteria, time limit and safe abort triggers.

task_definition.description: Pick up one lightweight object and place it entirely in a marked target area within a defined reachable workspace.
task_definition.success_condition: Object fully released inside marked target zone before task timeout, without operator intervention or a safety abort.
task_definition.failure_condition: Timeout, failed grasp, off-target release, loss of object, excessive deviation, human intervention or safety abort.
task_definition.time_limit_note: Set and freeze the time limit before collecting comparisons; do not invent one for unexecuted trials.

conditions.claim_scope: human-driven control reference, not learned-policy performance
ACT, exact checkpoint and training data pinned
Same SmolVLA checkpoint with asynchronous inference and recorded chunk settings

evaluation_design.note: 20 is an operational minimum for a first comparative report, not proof of statistical significance or generalization.
evaluation_design.balancing: Match object placements, camera geometry, environmental conditions and task resets; counterbalance run order and predefine random seed.
analysis: Raw successes and denominators including safety aborts
Wilson 95% interval or appropriately bounded interval for task success
p50/p95 and outliers for latency where measured
Per-category failure count and representative reproducible traces

timing_schema.timebase: monotonic nanoseconds within each machine; log UTC anchor separately; record inter-machine clock alignment when remote
timing_schema.caveat: Do not infer actuator-onset, real-time scheduling or motor-bus latency from dispatch timestamps alone.

publication_gate: Archived raw trial log + checksums and model/dataset revisions
Robot, camera, calibration, task, success/failure definitions frozen before trials
Predeclared and reported exclusions, aborted trials and recovery behavior
Source-linked examples and no invented latency or task-success figures
Verified reproducibility boundaries; no inference from one robot/task to universal performance
Explicit safety boundary: semantics and policy output do not authorize actuation
